segments.vv61:1.5: Obhāsento disā sabbā, osadhī viya tārakā.
segments.vv61:2.1: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv61:3.3: Pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv61:4.3: Pāṇātipātā virato ahosiṃ, loke adinnaṃ parivajjayissaṃ.
segments.vv61:5.1: “Amajjapo no ca musā abhāṇiṃ [abhāsiṃ (sī. ka.)], sakena dārena ca tuṭṭho ahosiṃ;
segments.vv61:5.3: Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
segments.vv61:6.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
